_comment: Player-facing phrasing for actor attributes, used by the actor info panel.
An attribute appears in the panel's trait sentence ONLY if it is listed here, so
engine plumbing (paint_tile, render_layer, deferred, ...) stays invisible by
default and nothing leaks just because it was added to an actor. Adding a new
attribute needs no engine change: give it an entry and it starts describing
itself; leave it out and it stays silent.
"phrase"                     — shown when the attribute is truthy
{ "true": ..., "false": ... } — shown for either state (omit a side to stay
silent for it; `false` also covers absent)
Phrases are verb phrases with no subject and no trailing period. The panel
supplies the subject and joins them: "The skeleton flies and sees in the dark."
Keep them short — several may share one sentence.
Order here is the order they read in the panel, so group related traits.
ignites: sets fire to what it touches
